title: PyTorch DLL init failure fix
content:
- Bug: `/api/system` endpoint returned 500 on Windows when `import torch` raised OSError (WinError 1114 — DLL init failure) instead of ImportError
- Fix: Changed `except ImportError:` to `except (ImportError, OSError):` at line 112 of src/litert_studio/server/app.py
- Impact: Endpoint now gracefully degrades to CPU-only info when PyTorch DLLs fail to load (missing MSVC redistributable, CUDA toolkit mismatch, or corrupted install)
- Other torch imports in reference.py, merge.py, transformers_backend.py are function-level imports inside job workers — they need torch to actually run, so their failures are appropriate
